notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
-sU against single UDP port with --reason shows exactly why Nmap assigned the state it did: 'udp-response' (service responded), 'port-unreach' (ICMP unreachable = closed), 'no-response' (filtered or open with no applicable probe).

=== DIAGNOSTIC ===
--reason removes ambiguity from 'open|filtered' state — shows whether it's silence (could be filtered or open) vs an actual ICMP error (definitive closed). Critical for understanding what's blocking vs what's listening.
